prompt: A town has one unusually cold, snowy winter during a period when its average temperature over 30 years has steadily risen. Which statement is most scientifically sound?

options.text: The cold winter proves the long-term warming trend is not happening
The long-term trend proves the cold winter cannot really have happened
Climate and weather are the same thing, so the two observations contradict each other
One winter is short-term weather, which varies a lot; climate is the long-term pattern, so a single cold season does not overturn it

explanation: Weather describes short-term conditions that fluctuate widely from year to year, while climate is the long-term average pattern. A single cold winter sits within natural variability and does not by itself change a multi-decade trend.
